name: Heart of Disruption
summary: The Image of Archmage Modera asks you to help contain an arcane disruption in Dalaran. The Violet Citadel’s wards are under strain, and the Kirin Tor need time to bring the crisis under control.

sections.title: A Way Inside
sections.body: The Image of Archmage Modera says the disturbance began at the top of the Violet Citadel, where a thunderous crash sounded from the parlors. Rampant arcane power now threatens the wards, and the Kirin Tor are occupied inside. You receive a key and are asked to find a less public way into the city before the disruption worsens.

sections.title: The Mote
sections.body: Modera asks you to collect an Arcane Mote. She does not ask what you saw in the citadel; her concern is containing the mote and ending the disruption. The Kirin Tor must now take up that work while the wards hold.

faq.answer: The Image of Archmage Modera asks you to help with the arcane disruption in Dalaran.
The disturbance began at the top of the Violet Citadel after a thunderous crash sounded from the parlors above.

faq.q: Why are the wards in danger?
faq.answer: Rampant arcane power has overrun the citadel, leaving the Kirin Tor struggling to keep the wards in place.

faq.q: What does Modera ask me to collect?
faq.answer: Modera asks you to collect an Arcane Mote.

faq.q: Why do I need a key?
faq.answer: Modera gives you a key so you can take a less public approach to entering the city.

faq.q: What happens after I bring back the mote?
aliases: what does modera do with it
faq.answer: Modera says the Kirin Tor must contain the mote and end the disruption.

attribution: In-game quest text: Heart of Disruption
